per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Routine browsing, searching, and loading of movie details shall respond within 5 seconds for users under typical conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Credit-card checkout flows (card processing) shall complete within 15 seconds under normal operating conditions; durations above 15 seconds are unacceptable.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Initial streaming startup buffering shall be single-digit seconds ideally and tolerable up to approximately 10 seconds including CDN and client setup; adaptive bitrate should recover quickly to minimize rebuffering.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: System availability shall be at least 99.5% over a rolling 30-day period.

Payment card data shall be stored only if necessary; otherwise rely on tokenization from a PCI-compliant processor. If card data is stored, it must be encrypted at rest and access limited to a very small set of administrators with strict controls.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'
